Such report shall include the following information regarding such sale or sales: a list of properties for which a tax lien or tax liens has or have been sold, including identification of the particular tax lien or tax liens sold; the proceeds received from the sale or sales of tax liens; identification of the purchaser of and servicer for the tax lien or tax liens sold; a report of servicer activities during the immediately preceding year; the redemption rate for tax liens that have been sold; the delinquency rate for real property taxes for the immediately preceding year; and any other information pertinent to the sale of tax liens that may be requested by the council and which is not made confidential pursuant to section 11-208.1 of the code.

candidates.agency: division of contracting and subcontracting opportunities (within the Department of Finance)
candidates.action_summary: Post opportunities for contracting and subcontracting at construction sites on the division's website.
candidates.quote: The division shall make information on such contracting and subcontracting opportunities available to the general public by posting such opportunities on its website.

candidates.action_summary: Establish specified daily penalties for immediately hazardous violations by rule.
candidates.quote: The commissioner may by rule establish such specified daily penalties.

candidates.action_summary: Establish specified monthly penalties for major violations by rule.
candidates.quote: The commissioner may by rule establish such specified monthly penalties.

candidates.action_summary: Prepare and issue laminated or similarly durable maps to fresh fruits and vegetables vendors designating areas of the city in which they are authorized to vend.
candidates.quote: a laminated or similarly durable and easily readable map, prepared and issued to them by the commissioner, designating those areas of the city in which they are authorized to vend

candidates.action_summary: Submit a written report to the speaker of the city council explaining any failure to hold required meetings or public hearings.
candidates.quote: Where the interagency coordinating council fails to hold such meetings or public hearings as required pursuant to this subdivision, a report shall be submitted in writing to the speaker of the city council including an explanation of the failure to hold such meetings or public hearings.

candidates.action_summary: Provide appropriate personnel to assist the interagency coordinating council in the performance of its functions.
candidates.quote: The commissioner of the department of homeless services shall provide appropriate personnel to assist the interagency coordinating council in the performance of its functions.

candidates.action_summary: Investigate failures to pay tobacco tax and enforce compliance with the chapter and promulgated rules.
candidates.quote: The commissioner of finance shall investigate any failure to pay the tax required by this chapter or any other failure to comply with this chapter or the rules or regulations promulgated thereunder, and shall take the necessary steps to enforce compliance therewith.

candidates.action_summary: Refund erroneous, illegal, or unconstitutionally collected taxes and process refund applications.
candidates.quote: In the manner provided in this subdivision the commissioner of finance shall refund, without interest, any tax, interest or penalty erroneously, illegally or unconstitutionally collected or paid.

candidates.action_summary: Enforce the provisions of subchapter 17-701 et seq. regarding tobacco product sales and pricing.
candidates.quote: The department of health and mental hygiene and the department of finance shall enforce the provisions of this subchapter.

candidates.action_summary: Enforce the provisions of chapter 2, subchapter 3 of title 17 relating to tobacco sales and licensing.
candidates.quote: The department, the department of consumer affairs and the department of finance shall enforce the provisions of this subchapter.

candidates.action_summary: Enforce the provisions of chapter 2, subchapter 3 of title 17 relating to tobacco sales and licensing.
candidates.quote: The department, the department of consumer affairs and the department of finance shall enforce the provisions of this subchapter.

candidates.action_summary: Enforce the provisions of chapter 2, subchapter 3 of title 17 relating to tobacco sales and licensing.
candidates.quote: The department, the department of consumer affairs and the department of finance shall enforce the provisions of this subchapter.

candidates.agency: Department of Social Services; Administration for Children's Services; Department of Homeless Services; Department of Health and Mental Hygiene; Department for the Aging; Department for Youth and Community Development; Department of Education; unspecified
candidates.action_summary: Provide all persons seeking services with a standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form containing questions regarding ancestry and languages spoken.
candidates.quote: shall provide all persons seeking such services with a standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form that contains questions regarding ancestry and languages spoken.

candidates.agency: Department of Social Services; Administration for Children's Services; Department of Homeless Services; Department of Health and Mental Hygiene; Department for the Aging; Department for Youth and Community Development; Department of Education; unspecified
candidates.action_summary: Provide all persons seeking services with a standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form containing an option for multiracial ancestry or ethnic origin.
candidates.quote: shall provide all persons seeking such services with a standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographic information survey form that contains an option for multiracial ancestry or ethnic origin.

candidates.agency: Department of Social Services; Administration for Children's Services; Department of Homeless Services; Department of Health and Mental Hygiene; Department for the Aging; Department for Youth and Community Development; Department of Education; unspecified
candidates.action_summary: Provide all persons seeking services who are at least 14 years old or identify as heads of their own households with a standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form containing questions regarding sexual orientation and gender identity.
candidates.quote: shall provide all persons seeking such services who are either at least 14 years old or identify as the heads of their own households with a standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form that contains questions regarding sexual orientation, including heterosexual, lesbian, gay, bisexual or asexual status or other, with an option to write in a response and gender identity, including transgender, cisgender or intersex status or other, with an option to write in a response.

candidates.action_summary: Submit to the council a report on any new or modified services developed by any agencies based on the demographic data collected on sexual orientation and gender identity.
candidates.quote: the office of operations shall submit to the council a report on any new or modified services developed by any agencies based on such data. Such report shall be submitted no earlier than 18 months after the effective date of the local law that added this paragraph.

candidates.action_summary: Require applicants to pay two times the actual cost for any additional inspections needed to verify completion of conversions, alterations, or improvements when work is not completed by the date of the department's initial inspection.
candidates.quote: the department of housing preservation and development shall require the applicant to pay two times the actual cost for any additional inspections needed to verify the completion of such conversion, alteration or improvement.

candidates.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary to implement the small business tax credit provisions, including rules to prevent abuse by related parties.
candidates.quote: The department of finance may promulgate any rules necessary to implement the provisions of this section, including, but not limited to, rules that prevent abuse of this section by related parties.

candidates.action_summary: Require each agency to prepare and submit periodic reports on the progress of capital projects, including schedules and explanations of delays, published at least three times each year.
candidates.quote: The mayor shall require each agency to prepare and submit periodic reports in regard to the progress of its capital projects, including schedules and clear explanations of any delays for particular projects and summary information on each agency's record on such matters.

candidates.action_summary: Promulgate any rules necessary for carrying out the provisions of the defibrillator requirements for youth baseball and softball leagues on city land.
candidates.quote: The commissioner of the department shall promulgate any rules as may be necessary for the purposes of carrying out the provisions of this section.

candidates.action_summary: Provide to youth leagues a sufficient number of automated external defibrillators and training courses at no cost.
candidates.quote: The department shall provide to youth leagues subject to the requirements of subdivision b a sufficient number of automated external defibrillators and training courses at no cost to such leagues.

candidates.action_summary: Promulgate any rules necessary for carrying out the provisions of the defibrillator requirements for youth recreation leagues in parks.
candidates.quote: The commissioner of the department shall promulgate any rules as may be necessary for the purposes of carrying out the provisions of this section.

candidates.action_summary: Promulgate regulations to provide for reinspection by a different departmental inspector upon request of the property owner.
candidates.quote: The department shall, by appropriate regulations, provide for a reinspection by a different departmental inspector than the inspector that conducted the first or original inspection upon request of the property owner to the appropriate borough office.

candidates.action_summary: Notify property owners of the date of reinspection at least five days prior to the reinspection date, when appropriate.
candidates.quote: Where appropriate, the department shall notify the property owner of the date of reinspection at least five days prior to the reinspection date.

candidates.action_summary: Issue a new order to the property owner specifying the results of reinspection, including a detailed diagram of the property and defects by type, and advising of procedures to challenge the notice of account or quality of work performed.
candidates.quote: The inspector conducting the reinspection shall file a new report and the department shall issue a new order to the owner specifying the results of the reinspection with a detailed diagram of the property and defects by type. Such order shall also advise the owner of the procedures utilized by the borough office as provided for in paragraph eighteen of subdivision a of section twenty-nine hundred three of the New York city charter and also of the right to challenge the notice of account and/or the quality of the work performed by filing a notice of claim with the office of the comptroller and thereafter a petition and commence a proceeding to review and/or correct the notice of account and/or the quality of the work performed under the direction of or by the department as provided in sections 19-152.2 and 19-152.3 of the code and specify the procedures as to how to appeal by filing a notice of claim with the office of the comptroller of the city of New York and how to file a petition and commence a proceeding to review and/or correct the notice of account and/or the quality of the work performed and the location where the forms may be obtained.

candidates.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the mayor and speaker of the council on compliance with school bus retrofitting and emissions standards, including data on age and crankcase retrofit status of every school bus under contract and yearly verification reviews of a sample from at least ten different vendors.
candidates.quote: No later than December 31, 2011 and no later than December 31 of every year thereafter, the department of education shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council on compliance with this section.

candidates.action_summary: Perform yearly reviews on a sample of school buses from at least ten different vendors to verify the accuracy of data reported on age and crankcase retrofit status.
candidates.quote: The department of education shall also perform yearly reviews on a sample of school buses from at least ten different vendors to verify the accuracy of data reported.

candidates.agency: the Commissioner of the Division of Labor Services
candidates.action_summary: Review all employment reports submitted by contracting agencies to determine whether contractors and subcontractors comply with equal employment opportunity requirements of local, state, and federal law and executive orders.
candidates.quote: The commissioner shall review all employment reports to determine whether such contractors and subcontractors are in compliance with the equal employment opportunity requirement of local, state and federal law and executive orders.

candidates.action_summary: Report to the mayor and speaker of the council, and make publicly available online, a report on implementation of section 3321 of the New York city building code no later than three months after the end of each fiscal year.
candidates.quote: No later than three months after the end of each fiscal year, the commissioner shall report to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and make publicly available online, a report on implementation of section 3321 of the New York city building code.

candidates.citation: NYC Building Code § 3302.1, definition of Site Safety Training (SST) Provider, Item 1.1
candidates.action_summary: Establish the form and manner for site safety training providers to demonstrate sufficient knowledge of the building code chapter when conducting training for SST credits.
candidates.quote: such person demonstrates sufficient knowledge of this chapter in a form and manner established by the department

candidates.action_summary: Convene the first meeting of the nightlife advisory board.
candidates.quote: The first meeting of the nightlife advisory board shall be convened within 120 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section.

candidates.action_summary: Submit recommendations to the mayor and the council on issues relating to nightlife establishments.
candidates.quote: Within 18 months of the effective date of the local law that added this section, the nightlife advisory board shall submit recommendations to the mayor and the council.

candidates.action_summary: Keep a record of its deliberations and determine its own rules of procedure, including a procedure or mechanism by which members of the public may make submissions to the board.
candidates.quote: The nightlife advisory board shall keep a record of its deliberations and determine its own rules of procedure, which shall include a procedure or mechanism by which members of the public may make submissions to the board.

candidates.action_summary: Publish and submit to the mayor, council and the commission on equal employment practices an annual report on the city's efforts to collect racial and ethnic demographic information, including analysis of employee response rates and racial classification categories.
candidates.quote: No later than September 30, 2020, and no later than September 30 annually thereafter, publish and submit to the mayor, council and the commission on equal employment practices a report on the activities of the department of citywide administrative services and city agencies

candidates.action_summary: Establish procedures to permit doctors, nurses, or other health professionals to request department investigations of possible indoor allergen hazards in dwellings where persons with moderate persistent or severe persistent asthma reside.
candidates.quote: The department shall establish procedures to permit doctors, nurses, or other health professionals, upon the consent of their patients, to request a department investigation of possible indoor allergen hazards

candidates.action_summary: Investigate possible indoor allergen hazards when notified that a person with moderate persistent or severe persistent asthma is residing in a dwelling with such hazards not otherwise subject to enforcement by the department of housing preservation and development.
candidates.quote: The procedures shall also provide for an investigation to be made when the department is notified that a person who has been medically diagnosed with moderate persistent or severe persistent asthma is residing in a dwelling with possible indoor allergen hazards

candidates.action_summary: Determine by rule from time-to-time what conditions constitute indoor allergen hazards beyond mold and construction dust.
candidates.quote: such other conditions as the department shall from time-to-time determine by rule are indoor allergen hazards

candidates.action_summary: For every report, study, audit or evaluation required by law that contains data in list, table, graph, chart or other non-narrative form, transmit such data to the council in non-proprietary format permitting automated processing.
candidates.quote: After July 1, 2019, for every such report or study that contains data in a list, table, graph, chart or other non-narrative form, the head of each agency shall also transmit such data to the council in a non-proprietary format that permits automated processing

candidates.action_summary: Ascertain from the office of the chief medical examiner the cause of death for any civilian fire fatality and ensure the annual report disaggregates data by each type of cause.
candidates.quote: The department shall ascertain from the office of the chief medical examiner the cause of death for any civilian fire fatality, as defined by such office.

candidates.action_summary: Require installations of exit signs, emergency means of egress illumination, sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, and alternative automatic fire extinguishing systems to be in accordance with the code.
candidates.quote: the fire commissioner shall require such installations to be in accordance with this code

candidates.action_summary: Review and approve construction documents for fire alarm systems prior to system installation.
candidates.quote: Construction documents for fire alarm systems shall be submitted for review and approval to the Fire Department prior to system installation.

candidates.action_summary: Review and approve construction documents for ARCS (fire department in-building auxiliary radio communication systems) prior to system installation.
candidates.quote: Construction documents for ARCS shall be submitted for approval to the Fire Department prior to system installation.

candidates.action_summary: Conduct investigations to identify potential sources of elevated blood lead levels in children, including inspecting dwelling units, covered facilities, and parks or playgrounds with bare soil where the child is routinely present.
candidates.quote: whenever a report has been made to the department of a person under 18 years of age with an elevated blood lead level that is at or above the blood lead reference level established pursuant to this subchapter, the department shall conduct such investigation as may be necessary to identify potential sources of such elevated blood lead level

candidates.action_summary: Conduct investigations and screenings for pregnant persons with elevated blood lead levels, including screening their children after birth for elevated blood lead levels and assessing dwelling units for lead-based paint hazards.
candidates.quote: Whenever a report has been made to the department of a pregnant person with an elevated blood lead level, the department shall (i) conduct such investigation as may be necessary to identify potential sources of such elevated blood lead level, and (ii) after the birth of a child by such pregnant person, screen such child for elevated blood lead levels

candidates.action_summary: Conduct outreach to new parents and persons expecting to become parents regarding the availability of inspections for lead hazards, blood lead testing, unsafe construction or renovation work practices.
candidates.quote: The department shall conduct outreach to any new parent or person imminently expecting to become a parent regarding the availability of inspections conducted pursuant to section 27-2056.9. Such outreach shall include information about blood lead testing for children, unsafe construction or renovation work practices

candidates.action_summary: Within 15 days of receipt of a commissioner's order to abate for lead-based paint hazards or unsafe lead paint in a specific dwelling unit in a multiple dwelling, notify the building owner that the owner shall provide all records required to be maintained under lead paint regulations.
candidates.quote: When the department of health and mental hygiene issues a commissioner's order to abate pursuant to section 173.13 of the New York city health code or a successor rule that addresses lead-based paint hazards or unsafe lead paint in a specific dwelling unit in a multiple dwelling, the department, within 15 days of the receipt of such order, shall notify the owner of the multiple dwelling

candidates.action_summary: Within 10 days of the end of the record order production period, attempt to inspect dwelling units where a child of applicable age resides to determine whether there are violations of lead paint regulations.
candidates.quote: Upon the department's receipt of those records and a determination that there may exist uncorrected lead-based paint hazards in dwelling units where a child of applicable age resides, the department within 10 days of the end of the record order production period, shall attempt to inspect units where a child of applicable age resides to determine whether there are any violations

candidates.action_summary: Within fifteen days of issuing a commissioner's order to abate lead-based paint or unsafe lead paint hazards, notify the owner of the multiple dwelling that the owner must provide all records required under the article within forty-five days.
candidates.quote: the department, within fifteen days of such order, shall notify the owner of the multiple dwelling where the dwelling unit is located that the owner shall, within forty-five days of the department's notice, provide to the department all records required to be maintained under this article

candidates.action_summary: Within ten days of receipt of records and determination that uncorrected lead-based paint hazards may exist in dwelling units with children, attempt to inspect such units for violations.
candidates.quote: the department within ten days shall attempt to inspect such units to determine whether there are any violations of section 27-2056.6 of this article

candidates.action_summary: Conduct investigation to identify potential sources of elevated blood lead level when a report is made of a person under eighteen with an elevated blood lead level at or above the blood lead reference level, including inspection of the dwelling unit.
candidates.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall conduct such investigation as may be necessary to identify potential sources of the elevated blood lead level, including but not limited to, an inspection of the dwelling unit where such person resides

candidates.action_summary: Notify the Department of Housing Preservation and Development of each dwelling unit in a dwelling for which the department has issued an order to correct a violation.
candidates.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall notify the department of each dwelling unit in a dwelling for which the department of health and mental hygiene has issued an order to correct a violation

candidates.action_summary: Certify conditions to the Department of Housing Preservation and Development within sixteen days of the report of elevated blood lead level when the owner fails to comply with an order to correct a violation.
candidates.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall certify such conditions to the department of housing preservation and development. The certification procedure shall be completed within sixteen days of the report of the elevated blood lead level

candidates.action_summary: Make at least one lactation room available upon request at every job center, SNAP center, or medical assistance program center, where practicable.
candidates.quote: Every job center, SNAP center, or medical assistance program center of the department of social services/human resources administration; city-owned borough office of the administration for children's services and the Nicholas Scoppetta children's center; and health center operated or maintained by the department shall, where practicable, make at least one lactation room available upon request

candidates.action_summary: Create a poster containing information on breastfeeding, the right to nurse in public, and availability of lactation rooms, and display it in lactation rooms and waiting rooms where required.
candidates.quote: The department shall create a poster containing information on breast-feeding, an individual's right to nurse in public, and the availability of lactation rooms pursuant to this section. Such poster shall be made available on the department's website, shall be displayed in any lactation room required to be made available pursuant to this section, and shall be displayed in a clear and conspicuous manner in the waiting room of any public space where a lactation room is required

candidates.action_summary: Create and publish on the department website a list of all locations with lactation rooms available.
candidates.quote: No later than one year after the effective date of the local law adding this subdivision, the department shall create a list of all locations with lactation rooms available pursuant to this section. Such list shall be made available on the department's website.

candidates.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the city council an annual report summarizing policies at New York City public schools to allow students or parents/guardians access to a lactation room upon request, and how such policies were communicated.
candidates.quote: The department of education shall submit to the speaker of the city council on or before August 1, 2017, and on or before every August 1 thereafter, a report summarizing the policies at New York city public schools to allow a student or the parent or guardian of a student access to a lactation room upon request. Such report shall indicate how information regarding such policies was communicated to students, parents and guardians during the previous school year.

candidates.action_summary: Specify in notices of violation that violations shall be corrected in accordance with work practices established by the department.
candidates.quote: The notice of violation shall further specify that the violation shall be corrected in accordance with the work practices established in accordance with section 27-2056.11 of this code.

candidates.action_summary: Serve notices of violation on building owners or managing agents by personal delivery, registered or certified mail, or certified mail with proof of delivery, and simultaneously send notification to the occupant by regular mail.
candidates.quote: The notice of violation shall be served by personal delivery to a person in charge of the premises or to the person last registered with the department as the owner or agent, or by registered or certified mail, return receipt requested, or by certified mail with proof of delivery, to the person in charge of the premises or to the person last registered with the department as the owner or agent; provided that where a managing agent has registered with the department, such notice of violation shall be served on the managing agent. Service of the notice of violation shall be deemed completed three days from the date of mailing. Notification, in a form to be determined by the department, of the issuance of such violation shall be sent simultaneously by regular mail to the occupant at the dwelling unit that is the subject of such notice of violation.

candidates.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing criteria for postponement of violation correction deadlines for longer periods when substantial capital improvements will significantly reduce the presence of lead-based paint.
candidates.quote: The department is also authorized to promulgate rules establishing criteria for a postponement of the time to correct for a longer period of time where such postponement is requested because of one or more substantial capital improvements will be made that will, when completed, significantly reduce the presence of lead-based paint in such multiple dwelling or dwelling unit including, but not limited to, a requirement that the paint which is the subject of the violation is stabilized.

candidates.action_summary: Provide written statements signed and dated by the decision-maker to the owner and occupant setting forth reasons for postponement decisions or denials of postponement requests.
candidates.quote: The department shall provide to the owner and the occupant a written statement signed and dated by the person making such decision setting forth the reasons for each postponement of the date by which a violation shall be corrected or the reason for the denial of such application for a postponement.

candidates.action_summary: Send a notice addressed to the dwelling unit for which a lead paint violation was issued, including a telephone number for the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene.
candidates.quote: The department shall send a notice which shall be addressed to the dwelling unit in the multiple dwelling, when a dwelling unit is identified, for which a violation of this article was issued. Such notice shall include a telephone number for the department of health and mental hygiene.

candidates.action_summary: Conduct investigation to identify potential sources of elevated blood lead level when a report has been made of a person under eighteen years of age with an elevated blood lead level residing in any dwelling unit, including inspection of the dwelling unit.
candidates.quote: Whenever a report has been made to the department of health and mental hygiene of a person under eighteen years of age with an elevated blood lead level that is at or above the blood lead reference level established pursuant to section 17-912 residing in any dwelling unit, the department of health and mental hygiene shall conduct such investigation as may be necessary to identify potential sources of the elevated blood lead level, including but not limited to, an inspection of the dwelling unit where such person resides.

candidates.action_summary: Notify the Department of Housing Preservation and Development of each dwelling unit in a dwelling for which the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene has issued an order to correct a lead violation.
candidates.quote: If the department of health and mental hygiene issues an order to correct any violation, the department of health and mental hygiene shall notify the department of each dwelling unit in a dwelling for which the department of health and mental hygiene has issued an order to correct a violation.

candidates.action_summary: Certify non-complying lead violation conditions to the Department of Housing Preservation and Development within sixteen days of the report of elevated blood lead level when owner fails to comply with an order to correct.
candidates.quote: Where the owner of the dwelling or relevant dwelling unit within such dwelling fails to comply with an order of the department of health and mental hygiene to correct a violation placed by the department of health and mental hygiene, the department of health and mental hygiene shall certify such conditions to the department of housing preservation and development. The certification procedure shall be completed within sixteen days of the report of the elevated blood lead level.

candidates.action_summary: Conduct an inspection of 10 percent of tenant protection plan sites within seven days after commencement of work to verify compliance with the tenant protection plan.
candidates.quote: The department shall conduct an inspection of 10 percent of such sites within seven days after the commencement of such work to verify compliance with the tenant protection plan.

candidates.action_summary: Conduct follow-up inspections of tenant protection plan sites every 180 days until construction is completed to verify compliance with the building code and tenant protection plan.
candidates.quote: The department shall conduct follow up inspections of such sites every 180 days until such construction is completed to verify compliance with the building code and tenant protection plan.

candidates.action_summary: Conduct an inspection within 10 days of receipt of a complaint concerning tenant protection plan work.
candidates.quote: Thereafter, the department shall conduct an inspection within 10 days of receipt of a complaint concerning such work.

candidates.action_summary: Create or approve a form for notices regarding tenant protection plans to occupants of buildings.
candidates.quote: The notice shall be in a form created or approved by the department

candidates.action_summary: Conduct investigations to identify potential sources of elevated blood lead levels in persons under 18 years of age, including inspections of dwelling units where such persons are routinely present for 10 or more hours per week.
candidates.quote: whenever a report has been made to the department of a person under 18 years of age with an elevated blood lead level that is at or above the blood lead reference level established pursuant to this subchapter, the department shall conduct such investigation as may be necessary to identify potential sources of such elevated blood lead level, including, but not limited to, an inspection of any dwelling unit

candidates.action_summary: Submit to the council the text of any proposed rule relating to the maximum capacity of commuter vans at the time such proposed rule is published in the City Record.
candidates.quote: The commission shall submit to the council the text of any proposed rule relating to the maximum capacity of commuter vans at the time such proposed rule is published in the City Record.

candidates.action_summary: Provide to the council a written annual report on the department's implementation of lead-based paint hazard prevention and control during the preceding fiscal year, including analysis of the department's program, revenue and expenditures, and detailed enforcement statistics.
candidates.quote: the commissioner shall provide to the council a written report on the department's implementation of this article during the preceding year. Such report shall include, at a minimum, an analysis of the department's program, a detailed statement of revenue and expenditures and statistical section designed to provide a detailed explanation of the department's enforcement

candidates.action_summary: Maintain a central register of all department orders to correct violations under the article, indicating the date of complaint, address of premises, and dates of inspections and reinspections.
candidates.quote: The department shall maintain a central register of all department orders to correct a violation under this article. Such register shall indicate, if applicable, the date of the complaint, address of the premises, and the date of each inspection and reinspection.

candidates.action_summary: Establish by rule requirements or exceptions to ensure the privacy and safety of employees regarding work schedule posting and notification.
candidates.quote: The department may by rule establish requirements or exceptions necessary to ensure the privacy and safety of employees.

candidates.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing the fee to be paid to the department and any method used to calculate the number and size of replacement trees required to be planted, including requirements that replacement trees equal one caliper inch per caliper inch removed, limits on caliper inches in R1, R2 and R3 zoning districts, and compliance with the most recent version of the guide for plant appraisal published by the council of tree and landscape appraisers.
candidates.quote: The department shall promulgate such rules as may be necessary to implement the provisions of this section, including but not limited to rules governing the fee to be paid to the department and any method used to calculate the number and size of the replacement trees required to be planted

candidates.action_summary: Create a form or manner for applicants to submit applications and supporting documentation to correct sex designation on birth records.
candidates.quote: Such application shall be made in a form or manner to be provided or approved by the department.

candidates.action_summary: After opportunity for a hearing, exclude, suspend, or otherwise condition the participation of registered design professionals who knowingly or negligently submit false or non-compliant professionally certified applications or submit two such applications within 12 months containing errors resulting in permit revocation or demonstrating incompetence.
candidates.quote: The commissioner shall, after the opportunity for a hearing before the office of administrative trials and hearings in accordance with department rules, exclude, suspend, or otherwise condition the participation of a registered design professional

candidates.action_summary: Create and maintain a database of all registered design professionals who have been excluded, suspended, or otherwise sanctioned.
candidates.quote: The department shall create and maintain a database of all registered design professionals who have been excluded, suspended or otherwise sanctioned by the department.

candidates.action_summary: Provide requested information concerning the exclusion, suspension, or other sanction of a specific registered design professional.
candidates.quote: The department shall provide requested information concerning the exclusion, suspension or other sanction of a specific registered design professional within 30 days of such request.

candidates.action_summary: Promptly transmit to the council copies of all final reports or studies required by the charter or other law.
candidates.quote: The head of each agency shall promptly transmit to the council copies of all final reports or studies which the charter or other law requires the agency or any official thereof to prepare.

candidates.action_summary: Promptly transmit to the council copies of all final audits, audit reports and evaluations of the agency prepared by state or federal officials or by private parties.
candidates.quote: The head of each agency shall also promptly transmit to the council copies of all final audits, audit reports and evaluations of such agency prepared by state or federal officials or by private parties.

candidates.citation: Section 28-103.33.4 of the New York City Administrative Code
candidates.action_summary: Maintain a website and post the office's contact information and a statement indicating that any person may contact the office with comments, questions or complaints.
candidates.quote: The office of alternative energy shall maintain a website and shall post on such website the contact information for such office and a statement indicating that any person may contact such office if such person has a comment, question or complaint with respect to such office.

candidates.action_summary: After notice and opportunity to be heard, issue orders to discontinue operations, seal premises, or remove vehicles/devices used in violations of sections 16-505 or 16-524, and post such orders at the premises.
candidates.quote: the commission shall, after notice and the opportunity to be heard, be authorized: to order any person in violation of such provisions immediately to discontinue the operation of such activity at the premises from which such activity is operated; to order that any premises from which activity in violation of such provisions is operated shall be sealed, provided that such premises are used primarily for such activity; and to order that any vehicles or other devices or instrumentalities utilized in the violation of such provisions shall be removed, sealed, or otherwise made inoperable.
